name: otzaria-web
description: The static, searchable, accessible Otzaria library on the web

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/index-search.mjs && node scripts/index-external-search.mjs && node scripts/check-size.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run serve
